id./param/scenario/cs/a_130_cs_080.pack|cs_: "Hey! ...I said, HEY! What's with all the waving around?
"Yes, what are they all doing, I wonder? And what about this mural? It's the same as the one from the ruins. Who is she?
"I don't know, but she's a charmer alright! She's certainly got this lot under her spell!
Hm hm! Does my beauty not captivate you too, child? Perhaps when you are a little older...
Ha ha ha ha! Why so confused, little ones? I am here! Right here!
"Let me see now... Red, orange, yellow, green... All the colours of the rainbow! The seven of you will be very welcome here!
"Especially you... There is something...different about you... Something particularly...vibrant...
"Now come, little ones... Brighten my world... Let me squeeze the colour from you as I did the others...
"Mm hm ha ha! You will soon be immortalised in vivid streaks of colour! Ah ha ha haaa!
"You don't need to tell me what a bad idea this is, but we need to find Dora. Let's grab her and get out of here!
